mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT EQP_G TEXT,EQP_G VAL FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD T WHERE T.MODULE=#{module}) ORDER BY TEXT
SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT EQP_G TEXT,EQP_G VAL FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD T WHERE T.MODULE=#{module}) ORDER BY TEXT
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'ALL' TEXT,'ALL' VAL FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT TECH TEXT,TECH VAL FROM A3MFGYW1.PRODG_INFO ) ORDER BY TEXT

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT NULL EQP_G, NULL MNPD_ID, NULL PRODG1, NULL PRODSPEC_ID, NULL OPER_NO, NULL WIP_DTH, NULL WIP_CLOSE_1D, NULL WIP_CLOSE_3D, NULL WIP_CLOSE_7D, NULL WIP_CLOSE_14D, NULL INPUT_30D, NULL MODULE_OWNER, NULL GROUP_TECH
,CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN WIP_CLOSE_7D > 100 THEN OPER_NO ELSE NULL END) = 0 THEN TO_CHAR(0) ELSE ROUND( (
COUNT(CASE WHEN (("${eqp}"='OK') OR ("${eqp}" LIKE 'MFG%' AND "${eqp}" NOT LIKE '%RMS%' AND "${eqp}" NOT LIKE '%RDS%' AND "${eqp}" NOT LIKE '%APC%')) AND WIP_CLOSE_7D > 100 THEN OPER_NO ELSE NULL END)
/ COUNT(CASE WHEN WIP_CLOSE_7D > 100 THEN OPER_NO ELSE NULL END)) * 100, 1 ) || '%' END "${eqp}"
,NULL CNT, NULL RCP_IDENT FROM ( SELECT A.*, 0 CNT FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT EQP_G, FLOW_ID MNPD_ID, PRODG1, PRODSPEC_ID, OPE_NO OPER_NO, D1 WIP_DTH, D1 WIP_CLOSE_1D, D3 WIP_CLOSE_3D, D7 WIP_CLOSE_7D, D14 WIP_CLOSE_14D, INPUT_30D, COMMON_ID, COMM FROM ${tb} WHERE EQP_G = '${eqpg}' AND FAB = '${fab}'
AND (
PRODG1 LIKE '%' || #{item} || '%'
)
AND (
PRODSPEC_ID LIKE '%' || #{item} || '%'
)
AND (
OPE_NO LIKE '%' || #{item} || '%'
)
AND RCP_IDENT LIKE '%${recipe}%'
AND GROUP_TECH='${tech}'
) PIVOT ( MAX(COMM) FOR COMMON_ID IN (
'${eqp}' "${eqp}"
) ) ) A ) UNION ALL
SELECT AA.*, CC.RCP_IDENT FROM ( SELECT A.*, 0 CNT FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT EQP_G, FLOW_ID MNPD_ID, PRODG1, PRODSPEC_ID, OPE_NO OPER_NO, D1 WIP_DTH, D1 WIP_CLOSE_1D, D3 WIP_CLOSE_3D, D7 WIP_CLOSE_7D, D14 WIP_CLOSE_14D, INPUT_30D, COMMON_ID, COMM,MODULE_OWNER,GROUP_TECH FROM ${tb} WHERE EQP_G = '${eqpg}' AND FAB = '${fab}'
AND (
PRODG1 LIKE '%' || #{item} || '%'
)
AND (
PRODSPEC_ID LIKE '%' || #{item} || '%'
)
AND (
OPE_NO LIKE '%' || #{item} || '%'
)
AND RCP_IDENT LIKE '%${recipe}%'
AND GROUP_TECH='${tech}'
) PIVOT ( MAX(COMM) FOR COMMON_ID IN (
'${eqp}' "${eqp}"
) ) ) A ) AA
,( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT T.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY T.EQP_G,T.FLOW_ID,T.PRODG1,T.PRODSPEC_ID,T.OPE_NO ORDER BY LENGTH(RCP_IDENT)) RN FROM ${tb} T WHERE EQP_G = '${eqpg}' AND FAB = '${fab}' ) WHERE RN = 1 ) CC
WHERE AA.EQP_G = CC.EQP_G(+) AND AA.MNPD_ID = CC.FLOW_ID(+) AND AA.PRODG1 = CC.PRODG1(+) AND AA.PRODSPEC_ID = CC.PRODSPEC_ID(+) AND AA.OPER_NO = CC.OPE_NO(+)
) ORDER BY NVL(WIP_CLOSE_7D, 9999999999999) DESC
